caption: The drawing depicts a transparent glass pitcher with a handle and a pedestal base, rendered in muted tones of beige, light brown, and pale green to suggest reflections and the clarity of the glass. The surface of the pitcher is decorated with an embossed floral pattern that appears slightly raised. Surrounding the pitcher, there are five outlined sketches, each in a rectangular box: two boxes above the pitcher contain line drawings of floral and fruit motifs, while two boxes on the right side depict ornamental patterns and the outline of a pedestal, each labeled “Exact.” The composition is centered on the pitcher, which occupies the largest area, with the sketches serving as decorative and contextual elements around it. The sheet is cream-colored, and all line drawings are done in a fine, light hand, adding detail to the objects depicted. The name "Manuel G. Freyman" is written at the bottom left, and "Exact Size" can be seen at the bottom right.
title: Pitcher
